nonLabourLines.description: Stripe integration fees / sandbox & test transaction costs
Third-party accessibility audit (WCAG 2.2 AA certification support)
Legacy Oracle data migration tooling / consultancy license
Cloud infrastructure (staging + prod) for pipeline setup, first 3 months

assumptions: No historical actuals (real spend data) are available for this project; estimate is based purely on backlog point-sizing and rate card, not prior velocity.
1 story point ≈ 6-7 hours of blended engineering effort, adjusted per task type (integration/migration tasks weighted higher due to risk).

Backend Developer (1.5 FTE = ~240 hrs/month) carries most API, integration, migration and security work; total backend hours are stretched across the roadmap length (~9-10 months) rather than compressed.
Frontend Developer (1.0 FTE = ~160 hrs/month) owns UI/component library, dashboard, responsive/accessibility work.

QA Engineer (0.6 FTE = ~96 hrs/month) is thinly staffed relative to backlog size (24 items incl. payments, RBAC, migration); test coverage will be risk-based rather than exhaustive - flagged as a staffing risk.
DevOps Engineer (0.4 FTE = ~64 hrs/month) covers CI/CD, staging, observability and decommission tasks only; ongoing operational support beyond setup is out of scope for this estimate.
Legacy data migration (PW-8) assumed to require significant one-off tooling/consultancy spend beyond labour, included as non-labour.
Estimate assumes backlog is delivered largely sequentially by priority (Urgent/High first) over roughly 9-10 months with the given FTE capacity; parallelism limited by thin QA/DevOps staffing.
Non-labour costs are illustrative estimates for third-party tools/services since no vendor quotes were provided.
Points-to-hours ratio and role split are heuristic; actual effort will vary once tasks are refined into sub-tasks with acceptance criteria.
input.reasoning: "Total backlog is 205 story points across 24 tasks. Using a blended ~6.5 hrs/point baseline (higher for integration-heavy items like Payment Provider, Legacy Migration, RBAC, 2FA due to security/compliance risk; lower for simpler CRUD/UI screens), total engineering effort is roughly 4,500-4,700 hours. This was distributed across the four staffed roles in proportion to their FTE availability and the nature of the work: Backend Developer takes the largest share (auth, RBAC, payments, migration, GDPR, rate limiting, audit log), Frontend Developer covers UI-heavy items (design system, dashboards, responsive/accessibility, search UI), QA Engineer is allocated risk-based testing hours skewed toward Urgent/High items given only 0.6 FTE capacity, and DevOps Engineer is limited to pipeline setup, observability and decommissioning given 0.4 FTE. Labour subtotal is ~$416K. Non-labour additions (migration tooling, accessibility audit, Stripe sandbox costs, infra, contingency) bring most-likely total to ~$480K. Optimistic scenario assumes lower-than-expected complexity on migration/multi-currency and no major rework; pessimistic assumes QA/DevOps thin-staffing causes schedule slip, rework on payment/migration integration, and additional non-labour spend on accessibility remediation or migration consultancy. Priority breakdown approximates cost by summing role hours per task priority using the same points-to-hours heuristic, then applying blended rates."
